inferences.fact: Changing only that Boolean to false suppresses the native text-search host-upgrade expansion without changing core compatibility, modules, dependencies, signature checks or paid-plugin license terms.

MarketplaceCustomizationService exposes URLs, while PluginManagementPolicy exposes install/enable/update permissions. Neither offers a local-mode result-filter toggle; combined-manager controller/customizer EPs are remote-mode conditional.
